newsitem.title: CANADA: Shell grosses C$760 mln from Shell Canada buyback.
newsitem.headline: Shell grosses C$760 mln from Shell Canada buyback.

text.p: Shell Canada Ltd on Friday confirmed the results of its major share buyback, a move that will see parent Royal Dutch/Shell Group gross about C$760 million ($550 million).
Shell Canada, which is 78 percent owned by Shell Investments Ltd, a Royal Dutch/Shell Canadian holding company, confirmed it would buy back 16 million of its shares at C$61 each.
Payment of the C$976 million ($707 million) total consideration was expected to be made on Monday.
The shares were being bought back to reduce Shell Canada's C$1.3 billion cash reserve, which was bolstered by the sale last year of its chemicals division, Shell Canada said.
Following the deal, Shell Canada will have 96.6 million class A shares outstanding, down from 112.6 million. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
